lines.5: Otome gave it a firm tug and fixed it for me.
lines.9: No. This was different from back then.
lines.10: My heart had never raced like this in the past.
lines.12: A clear beauty, like a Japanese sword beaded with water.
lines.13: 「W-well, that's the bell. I should go.」
lines.16: 「...Oh no. I became so absorbed in our memories that I forgot the matter I came to discuss.」
lines.17: 「(I am busy after school today. Perhaps I should call tonight. Tsushima's phone number was in the relatives section of the directory, if I remember correctly.)」
lines.18: 「How'd it go, buddy? Did she give you a thorough scolding?」
lines.21: So that person really was Big Sis Otome...
lines.22: More and more old memories came flooding back.
